Sam H.: heads-up — I'm about to hand off in ~30m. Observed a rising 5xx tail on model-serving-prod over the last 20m (p95 latency still ok, error rate ~6% -> 11%). If nobody swaps, there's a coverage gap 11:30–12:30 UTC.
Maria L.: on it — I can extend for the 11:30 slot if needed. what's the current mitigation? any active incident ticket?
Sam H.: triggered auto-alert but not a full incident yet. OpsBot posted an alert: \nopsbot: INCIDENT-8492 | model-serving-prod high 5xx rate | severity: medium | link: https://incidents.redwood/8492
(opsbot message)
OpsBot: Pager routed to pagers/infra; initial threshold = 5% 5xx sustained 5m.
Jin K.: i can take 11:45–12:15 if Maria prefers smaller window. otherwise i can be secondary remote.
Maria L.: thanks. Sam — can you paste the quick runbook steps? i want to know if we should page infra-oncall now or wait for 10m.
Ben S.: paste from runbook — short checklist: \n1) confirm traffic spike vs infra errors (query logs)\n2) check node OOM/CPU on gpu-pool-3\n3) scale down risky model versions or failover to smaller variant\n4) escalate to SRE lead if paging thresholds met\n
runbook-bot: extracting runbook snippet for INCIDENT-8492
```
TITLE: model-serving 5xx surge - quick mitigation
WHEN: >=5% 5xx sustained for 5m (or customer-visible failures)
IMMEDIATE ACTIONS:
  - set routing weight to fallback-model-v1: 100% (runtime control)
  - drain suspect workers: 
    kubectl -n inference cordon worker-42
    /scripts/drain_worker.sh worker-42 --grace 30
  - if GPU OOMs, set model_quant_profile=8bit (temp)
  - notify support and update incident channel
ESCALATION:
  - no ack from primary within 5m -> page secondary
  - no ack within 10m -> page SRE lead (pager: +1-555-0102)
  - sustained data-plane errors >15% -> declare Sev2 and open bridge
```

Sam H.: i'm seeing spikes centered on one AZ, tput unchanged. logs show `nv_peer_timeout` on 3 pods in gpu-pool-3. Ben — does draining worker-42 match those pods? If so, do it.
Ben S.: yep — those pods are on worker-42 and worker-43. i'm initiating a cordon+drain on 42 now. will monitor 2–3 min and report.
Maria L.: paging rules for this handoff: page order -> primary (current shift) -> secondary -> SRE lead -> Eng manager. Use voice pager if on Slack ack >5m absent. For customer-facing incidents, notify SupportOps and CSM team via #support-notify.
Jin K.: noted. If primary is in a meeting and can't ack, assume no-ack after 5m and page secondary. Also, if latency p95 jumps >200ms alongside >10% 5xx, escalate immediately.
OpsBot: automated note: incident alert threshold passed at 1729999850. Severity suggestion: medium. No bridge created.
Ben S.: drain done on worker-42, pods rescheduled onto worker-45, 5xx down to ~4.2% after ~90s. monitoring.
Maria L.: good — i'll stay on until full flatten back below 1% for 15m. Sam — you good to hand off now?
Sam H.: handing off now. My checklist: (1) incident queued in incidents.redwood (INC-8492) (2) ran drain on worker-42 (3) alerted SupportOps (DM sent) (4) left mitigation notes in runbook. :white_check_mark:
Maria L.: taking primary. i'll update incident channel and keep everyone posted. If 5xx crosses 10% again, i'll page SRE lead at +1-555-0102 and open bridge. :thumbsup:
